lines.trans: Let me tell you, this book has been my absolute treasure ever since I was little.
No matter how sad things got, the moment I read this book I pulled right through.
Would you not say that is pretty amazing?
I will step outside to check on things—do not be polite, call me right away if you need anything.
How is the boss doing?
Much better—he has some energy back. What happened, did the meeting go badly?
They plan to bypass the chief editor's office—the boss has been pushed out of his own show.
How could they possibly do that?
Worst of all, the chairwoman actually went along with it in silence.
The two of us are stepping down from production, including tonight's live finale—we stand or fall with our boss.
What do you think?
